hero.title: One plan our neighbors keep coming back to
hero.subtitle: Start with the setup that fits most homes, then explore a few other favorites. No annual contract, and a 5-year price guarantee on every plan.
spotlight.title: Xfinity Gig Internet
spotlight.body: Fiber-powered gig WiFi built for busy, always-online homes. Stream in 4K, game, and work from home across dozens of devices, with the xFi Gateway included so you self-install in minutes.
explore.title: Also worth exploring

item-1.title: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-1.body: Fast, consistent WiFi that keeps up with every device at once, with a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year.
item-2.title: Xfinity Mobile - Mobile Select
item-2.body: Unlimited talk, text, and data on the most reliable 5G network. Try a line free for a year with Internet.
item-3.title: StreamSaver and Streaming Apps
item-3.body: Peacock, Netflix, and Apple TV+ together on one simple bill with your Internet plan.
item-4.title: xFi Gateway
